# Learnlysis third-party software notices

Learnlysis's original code is licensed under the MIT License; see `LICENSE`.
This license does not replace the terms for third-party software, fonts, or
other assets included in the source tree or the release package.

## Included release: PySide6 v5 Windows onedir

The inspected package was built with PySide6 / Qt 6.8.3 and Python 3.11.3.
The Qt libraries and PySide6/shiboken6 bindings in this package are distributed
under the LGPLv3 option where that option is available. The LGPLv3 text is
included as `LGPL-3.0.txt`; the FFmpeg libraries used by Qt Multimedia have
LGPL-2.1-or-later terms, with the LGPL-2.1 text included as `LGPL-2.1.txt`.

The onedir package keeps the Qt DLLs and Python bindings as separate files under
`_internal`, so users can replace (替换) those libraries. Learnlysis application code
is MIT-licensed. This release's corresponding source for the unmodified Qt 6.8.3
libraries and PySide6 6.8.3 bindings is available to recipients from the official
[Qt 6.8.3 source archive](https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.8/6.8.3/single/) and
[PySide6 6.8.3 source archive](https://download.qt.io/official_releases/QtForPython/pyside6/PySide6-6.8.3-src/).
These locations are source retrieval instructions for this binary release. If a
distributed Qt/PySide library is modified, the corresponding modified source must
also be made available under its applicable license. Keep this onedir layout and
the ability to replace the shared libraries when redistributing the application.
If these libraries are modified, provide the corresponding modified source as
required by the applicable license. This notice is not a substitute for checking
the exact LGPL conditions for the release and distribution method.

The inspected build contained Qt Core, Gui, Multimedia, Network, OpenGL, PDF,
QML/Quick, SVG, Widgets and related plugins. Qt PDF and Qt Multimedia have an
LGPLv3 licensing option; this distribution uses that option. Qt Virtual Keyboard
is GPLv3-only (not LGPL; no commercial Qt license is used here) in the community edition and is not used by Learnlysis; its DLL
and plugin are excluded from this release. Do not re-add them to a build under
the MIT/LGPL release configuration. Qt's full component license details are in
the official [Qt 6.8 licensing page](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.8/licensing.html).

Qt Multimedia bundles FFmpeg 7.1 libraries. FFmpeg and the other third-party
components within Qt modules have their own licenses and notices. Consult the
official [Qt 6.8 third-party license inventory](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.8/licenses-used-in-qt.html),
[Qt Multimedia licensing and attribution](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.8/qtmultimedia-index.html),
and [Qt for Python third-party licenses](https://doc.qt.io/qtforpython-6.8/licenses.html).
The package's `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES` directory includes license texts available
from the bundled Python distributions, including OpenCV's third-party notices.

## MiSans fonts

The v5/v6 source and v5 package contain MiSans font files from Xiaomi. They are
not licensed under SIL OFL. The applicable terms are Xiaomi's MiSans Font
Intellectual Property License Agreement, included in
`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/MiSans-License-Agreement.pdf`. The agreement permits use
in applications, requires the software to identify MiSans, and requires the
copyright notice and agreement to be retained with font copies. It also
prohibits distributing the font files separately. The About dialog identifies
MiSans as the interface font; do not publish the font files as a standalone font
download. See the [official MiSans license](https://hyperos.mi.com/font/en/download/).

## Other bundled Python/runtime components

The release also includes Python 3.11.3 (Python Software Foundation License),
pandas (BSD 3-Clause), NumPy (BSD 3-Clause), SciPy (BSD 3-Clause), scikit-learn
(BSD 3-Clause), matplotlib (PSF-based license and third-party notices),
openpyxl (MIT), hmmlearn (MIT), NetworkX (BSD 3-Clause), joblib (BSD 3-Clause),
OpenCV (Apache-2.0 and its included third-party licenses), and transitive
dependencies. OpenSSL runtime libraries are also included: the 1.1.x libraries
use the OpenSSL/SSLeay license and the 3.x libraries use Apache-2.0. Their license texts are included where available in
`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES`; Python's license is `PYTHON-LICENSE.txt`.

The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs included in the package remain subject to
Microsoft's applicable redistribution terms.

Build tools include PyInstaller (GPLv2 with an exception for generated
executables) and Cython (Apache-2.0). Their licenses do not change the licenses
of the application or the runtime components.

Always retain the license files and copyright notices that accompany the
components in a release. Recheck the actual files in every newly built `dist`
directory before publishing it, since PyInstaller collection can change which
plugins and dependencies are present.
